reviewerContext: Independent clean-context child agent; supplied requirements, acceptance criteria and necessary project facts only.
scope: Current-thread native task-message evidence, the standalone Canvas Node service boundary and final MCP candidate follow-up; README native-tool paragraph, PLAN latest feasibility/boundary paragraphs and the corresponding runtime-validation section.
excludedScope: Functional MCP subscription or model-wakeup testing, runtime attachment, model execution and deployment revalidation.
Additional public implementation lookup after the executor's bounded HTTP 403 source-query result.

provenance.nativeMessageObservation: Parent-supplied authorized one-message dispatch and same-thread user-channel receipt facts, cross-checked against committed-for-review evidence. Reviewer did not repeat the dispatch or read conversation history.
provenance.productionHostStatus: Existing closure.json evidence; reviewer did not invoke the production service.
provenance.mcpSchema: Read-only checks against the executor-owned /tmp default and experimental static schema files; no generator, runtime, configuration or subscription invoked by reviewer.

checks.name: Native dispatch and actual receipt identity
checks.detail: Target, returned and received source thread IDs match 01a1310e-f0a0-739d-840b-74713f7ba0e9, hostId durable and ACANVAS_DESKTOP_ROUTE_TEST. Evidence records the codex_delegation envelope and assistant confirmation, no new/resumed thread, and zero Canvas claims.

checks.name: Agent tool versus independent service
checks.detail: Docs do not equate exposed hostId/threadId/prompt tool arguments with an independently callable endpoint or credential issuance flow. Missing service endpoint/authentication/thread binding is explicitly an unestablished route, not universal incompatibility.

checks.name: Local process ownership boundary
checks.detail: ENOENT daemon/proxy and known-PID metadata are limited local-route evidence. Durable-thread ownership by PID 94984 remains unproved and is not used to exclude all Desktop delivery.

checks.name: Production host status and execution boundary
checks.detail: Saved status is queue/none/not-attached with attachment null. pendingCount and unknownCount are explicitly host-delivery counts, not total queued tasks. Native dispatch/receipt is not treated as Canvas claim, execution or completion.

checks.name: Queue 9/9 and retry evidence
checks.detail: Actual result.json contains nine PASS checks and 52 command records. Same draft/revision retry returns the original task; exact completion identity returns the original receipt; injected lost completion response is followed by receipt query and same-receipt retry. Local queue guarantees are not promoted into native host message deduplication.

checks.name: Official documentation consistency
checks.detail: Fresh read-only SDK, MCP configuration and MCP Events source review supports the documented local-SDK, Codex-consumes-external-tools and published Work/Cloud/dots support scopes. None of the reviewed pages establishes this exact durable-thread app-tools route for the independent service; no blanket exclusion of Codex MCP events is asserted.

checks.name: JSON, relative links and whitespace
checks.detail: Six scoped live-host-route JSON files and queue result JSON parsed; closure evidence references exist; 151 local links and two Markdown heading anchors across README, PLAN, runtime validation and queue feasibility resolve; git diff --check passes.

checks.name: MCP schema and functional boundary
checks.detail: All 317 default and 447 experimental generated JSON files parse. Default ClientRequest lacks event-stream start/stop while ServerNotification includes notification; experimental schemas include all three exact methods. Start requires arguments/name/server/subscriptionId/threadId; notification requires notification/subscriptionId. Both saved parameter SHA-256 values match the raw generated files. Schema existence is not represented as current durable-thread subscription, negotiated capabilities or automatic model activation.

checks.name: MCP product implementation and source lookup
checks.detail: The recorded repository rg command independently returns only item/mcpToolCall/progress in codex-runtime.ts. No Canvas MCP server/event bridge is shown in the searched product source, package or Skill. The executor's single public-source API HTTP 403 is retained as a lookup blocker, not evidence of absent behavior. Catalog and logging notifications are distinguished from user input and functional wakeup.

resolvedFindings: Final validation prose corrected protocol shorthand to exact notifications/tools/list_changed and notifications/message names; reviewer verified both corrected names.
remainingProductBoundary: Independent Canvas service delivery into the current existing conversation is not connected. MCP event streams are a version-specific candidate with no current-thread subscription or functional wakeup test; saved project/session queue with explicit original-agent continuation remains the documented fallback.
